name: Langham Gold Coast & Jewel Residence
positioning: Beachfront Langham hotel (officially The Langham, Gold Coast) between Surfers Paradise and Broadbeach, with several restaurants and bars and Jewel Residences
best_for: Travelers who want a beachfront base on the Gold Coast with a choice of restaurants and bars

facts.text: The hotel is situated between Surfers Paradise and Broadbeach on the Gold Coast.
The hotel is conveniently accessed through Gold Coast and Brisbane International Airports.
The hotel's accommodation includes Jewel Residences by The Langham.
Akoya is a beachfront restaurant built around fresh, seasonal, locally sourced ingredients.
Palm Court has views of the lagoon pool.
26 & Sunny is a beachside spot serving food, coffee and deli items.
The Lobby Bar interiors are inspired by the colours of Queensland's ocean and Hinterland.
The hotel's concierge recommends HOTA, a cultural district with a sculpture walk and live shows, in Surfers Paradise.
The hotel's concierge recommends Sea World Marine Park as a family-friendly outing on the Gold Coast.

highlights.text: Palm Court serves the Langham Afternoon Tea, a contemporary interpretation of the tea service first served at The Langham, London in 1865.
T'ang Court is the hotel's contemporary Cantonese restaurant, pairing local produce with a bespoke wine list.
The hotel has a swim-up pool bar overlooking the Pacific Ocean in its lagoon pool.
Coral Moon is an open-air event space on level three overlooking the Pacific Ocean.

considerations.text: Coral Moon is available to hire as a private venue for events.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes the large resort scale may feel less intimate.
